summary.text: Ross Davenport is the Republican candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 18, 2026, and faces incumbent Democrat Karlee Provenza.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Laramie resident and educator.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Ross Davenport said his campaign messages are to protect taxpayers and make Wyoming more affordable, to support strong schools and the people who work in them, and to keep Wyoming decisions in Wyoming hands.

He said that includes keeping property taxes under control, demanding responsible state spending, and supporting competitive teacher pay while keeping education decisions accountable to parents and local communities.
He also listed water, data centers, property rights and government growth as issues on which he wants affected residents to have a voice.
